title: Passage: Peace and glory
standardSummary: Read a capstone mixed passage; show comprehension across Year 1 grammar.

passage.title: Peace and fame
passage.latin:
Augustus, quī prīnceps erat, pācem populō Rōmānō dedit.
Haec pāx ā multīs laudāta est.
Mīlitēs quī in prōvinciīs pugnāverant Rōmam redierunt.
Glōria Rōmae per terrās nārrātur.
Nōs hanc fāmam memoriā tenēmus.
